answer: Weight in our registry equals locked stake multiplied by identity age, sealed each epoch like rings in onyx. A newcomer calling itself yarrow earns nothing until its deposit has sat untouched for ninety epochs; only then does voting and earning weight accrue. An attacker spawning a nebula of fresh Sybils must therefore lock real capital in every single identity and wait months for each, so multiplying identities multiplies tied-up funds and delay instead of influence.
